The world and everything built in it are deleted for good.

An original block game made for HyPocket, open source and not related to any other game. Collect blocks and build with them (or pick creative mode for unlimited blocks), and keep your worlds. Your goal: light the five dark beacons hidden in the mist. Days pass and nights get dark: light them with lamps. It runs through the same path a real game will (x86-64 translator, desktop OpenGL and the direct display). Works with touch, game controllers, keyboards and mice (click to capture the pointer). The render scale, FPS limit, dynamic resolution and camera sensitivity are in Settings.
Heavy mode: 300 wandering creatures and a longer view (and a world four times larger in the quick game)
Left: walk · Right: drag to look, tap to break or hit · Bottom: choose a block
Left stick: walk · Right stick: look · A: jump · X/RT: break or hit · B/LT: place · Y: next block · Select: inventory · Start: menu
Mouse: move to look · Left button: break or hit · Right button: place · Wheel or 1-9: block · I: inventory · WASD: walk · Space: jump · Esc: free the pointer, then the menu
